data.one_liner: A flutter plugin for communicating with bluetooth classic devices.
data.what_it_does: Flutter_blue_classic is a flutter plugin that allows applications to communicate with bluetooth classic devices. It provides functions to check adapter states, scan for devices, bond, and manage connections.
use_when: You need to communicate with Bluetooth Classic devices on Android
You want to discover, pair, and connect to non-BLE Bluetooth hardware
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS (requires MFi certification and custom native code)
You need Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) support (use flutter_blue_plus instead)
strengths: Dedicated support for Bluetooth Classic on Android
Provides stream-based connection handling and adapter states
Includes helper functions for UTF-8 string transmission
weaknesses: Android only; iOS does not provide a similar Bluetooth Classic interface
Requires manual permission configuration in the Android manifest
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the minSdkVersion to 21 or higher and manually adding BLUETOOTH permissions to your AndroidManifest.xml.
